slug: 2019-01-01 Snapshot of CRVS Systems of Uganda (IDRC Centre of Excellence)

facts.fact: The snapshot, from a questionnaire NIRA completed in January 2019, states that NIRA, an authority under the Ministry of Internal Affairs, registers births and deaths and that their information is entered into the national database.
The snapshot states that a strategic plan for the improvement of CRVS systems has not been developed, Uganda having completed only a baseline survey, on NIRA's questionnaire of January 2019.

The snapshot states that information on budgetary requirements and allocations was not available, and lists World Bank, Global Financing Facility and UNICEF support to NIRA, on NIRA's questionnaire of January 2019.

The snapshot states that the registration of births and deaths is paper-based at the lowest registration centres and that the information is entered into the national database at regional level, on NIRA's questionnaire of January 2019.

The snapshot states that registration of births and deaths is paper-based at all of the lowest registration centres, that the information is entered into the national database at regional level, and that CDs and flash discs carry it from local centres to the next higher office, on NIRA's questionnaire of January 2019.

The snapshot states that all local registration offices have computers, beside a count of 152 district-level births and deaths registration offices, of which it puts 133 in rural and 19 in urban areas, while registration at the lowest centres stays on paper, on NIRA's questionnaire of January 2019.

systems.tiers: entered at regional level from paper registers of the lowest registration centres; 152 district-level registration offices, all with computers

systems.platform: mobile phone entry to a central database, developed with UNICEF and Uganda Telecom in 2013
systems.tiers: local government notifiers in communities report births by mobile phone; a few health facilities have computers
national; a National Identification Number is issued when a birth is registered, but the civil registration and identification systems are not electronically linked

note: Read from the artefact PDF. The snapshot describes the Mobile Vital Record System only as mobile notification of births, so it is entered as notification here and gives no fact; the civil facts are on the unnamed national database. For exchange: a NIN is issued at birth registration, yet the two NIRA systems are not electronically linked (January 2019). The office percentages the PDF prints (14 and 86 per cent) do not match its counts of 19 and 133 of 152.
